title: Campbell's Kitchen Chicken Broccoli Divan
description: This Campbell's chicken and broccoli casserole features cooked meat, condensed soup, and Cheddar cheese baked with a buttery bread crumb topping.
ingredients: 1 pound fresh broccoli, cut into spears
1.5 cups cubed cooked chicken or turkey
1 (10.75 ounce) can Campbell's® Condensed Broccoli Cheese Soup or Campbell's® Condensed 98% Fat Free Broccoli Cheese Soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C).

Arrange broccoli and cooked chicken in a 2-quart shallow baking dish or 9-inch pie plate. Stir together condensed soup and milk in a medium bowl until combined, then pour over all. Sprinkle with cheese. Mix together bread crumbs and melted butter in a small bowl; sprinkle on top.
Bake casserole in the preheated oven until hot, about 25 minutes.
